mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the rubble moon was the most worthwhile: it connected the disk's gathered solids to a moon that survives just outside the giant's disruptive region.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding dust to the disk was a modest intermediate step; the result explained that it wasn't needed for the moon to form.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the larger icy pieces could gather into a moon directly in the gas disk, without the dust preparation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the dust step had a clear purpose even though it was optional.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the different futures of the moon and the scattered icy bodies, especially after seeing how the giant shaped both.
